summary: Fort Island's stelling was rehabilitated at a cost of G$82M and commissioned on 24 May 2022 by Ministers Juan Edghill and Deodat Indar
The MV Malali resumed scheduled calls at Fort Island on 27 August 2022 after a gap of 13 years, on the Parika-Bartica run

The government announced free state-provided ferry transport to Fort Island for the 60th Independence flag-raising ceremony, run by the Ministry of Public Works with MARAD and announced by Minister Juan Edghill
Guyana's 60th Independence national flag-raising was held at Fort Island on the evening of Monday 25 May 2026, with the flag raised at midnight into 26 May
Following the ceremony the Tourism Ministry announced plans to 'permanently improve maritime access' at Fort Island - language implying current maritime access is not adequate
The MV Konawaruk 1899, formerly the ARIS IV, was commissioned in December 2025 at a cost of US$5M and is described as Guyana's first modern double-ended roll-on/roll-off ferry
Gives the MV Ma Lisha as length overall 69.55 m, beam 13.5 m, draught 3.0 m, displacement 1,700 tonnes
